title: Associate Project Manager - Supply Chain
text:
About the Role
You will coordinate cross-functional supply chain projects: supplier onboarding, warehouse system rollouts and inventory accuracy initiatives, tracking schedules, risks and budgets.
Requirements
2 years of experience in project management or supply chain operations.
Bachelor’s degree in engineering or business required.
Working knowledge of Excel and a project scheduling tool.
Preferred Qualifications
PMP or CAPM certification.
